acceptance_gate: Same immutable original NANDs and local certificates, one edited pin, paid independent raw-output and global frontier-minimum checks.
completion_gate: Compare exact programs, charged CPU and avoided work against strong cached ordinary controls. Train on fresh rules only after a repeatable supplied-fold win.
objective: Measure exact minimum-width circuit repair with shared NAND gates, shared local histories and one changed consumer. Give the old piece location to the fold first, charge construction and checking, and train a locator only on an observed speed advantage.
status: Exact on all 36 one-bit and 36 two-bit parent edits. With the original physical piece, the fold avoided 36 group tests but tied the ordinary repair in paid checking work; median total 398.361 vs 397.038 ms, four of eight paired wins. The learning gate stopped. Independent raw-circuit and timing replay passed.
stop_rule: Use the preselected parent stream and its conditional timing replay; preserve the training and blind reserves when the supplied fold fails its cost test.
title: Does a verified local fold save work after a consumer edit one level up?
